// A flat (N-1)-dimensional subspace of N-dimensional space: points p
// satisfying dot(Normal, p) = Distance. Normal is unit length; Distance
// (world units) is the signed distance from the origin.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyperplane)
type HyperplaneN
    implements IValue
{
    Normal: VectorN;
    Distance: Number;
}
